author: ANDREIBOSSLIKA
quote:
The game is boring! I'm already a couple of hours in and the only things that I do is repair the house, buy groceries for Lucia, fix the sink and so on. Jason is like a souless golem, he has no personallity what so ever, he's only getting cucked by Lucia which probably is the main character as intended. You can't kill people who protest, you can't steal cars in your neighbhourhood and you have this sort of honour thing, the game will punish you if you are violent. Not to mention that this game is filled with the LGTV agenda. The game does not capture the original GTA essence, this does not feel like a GTA game what so ever. We are forced into this boring relationship with Lucia. I did not pay 100$  to be cucked by a latina girl boss. The dialogues between characters are boring, everything is safe, sanitized, and politically correct. The original Rockstar humour is absent, no egdy jokes, no "offensive" phrases or anything. Again, if this was any other game than GTA I would probably rate it a lot higher but this is one of the biggest dissapointments of the century. This does not feel like an original GTA game. We waited 13 years for this btw.
NOT TO MENTION 30 FPS, the game sometimes drops at 24 FPS this is DISGUSTING and it makes me sick. Gta 6 didnt live up to the hype. Goy simulator, cucked simulator, don't waste ur money în this.
